definition: First stable GitHub release whose notes announce the usable protocol support API. Publication is the shipping proxy; compare UTC calendar dates against mainnet activation. Drafts do not render until verified is an ISO date.

upgrades.name: Protocol 27
upgrades.note: Verified 2026-09-22. Supporting release means the first stable release explicitly announcing the usable protocol API, not preliminary XDR adoption. Activation evidence is mainnet ledger data: ledger 63386819 closed at 2026-07-08T17:00:10Z with protocol_version 27; predecessor 63386818 has version 26.
